results.evidence: Third attempt. An archived route description of the South Gully puts Step 2 (a wet slab waterfall it calls its own crux) at about 3,400 ft and Step 3 (the jammed-boulder fall) at about 3,700 ft, with the gully reaching 4,000 ft just above it; this is the only source found that states the boulder-jam height, and it matches neither the prose's ~3,900 ft nor the waypoint's 3,600 ft. Another report's c.3,900 ft refers to a 20 ft tower, not clearly the same step, and the scramble-guide statement that the cave exit is 400-500 ft above the third falls would only yield a figure by subtraction. No two sources agree on the crux height, so nothing is changed.

results.correct_value: The Fisher Creek / south-basin line that approach, waypoints, approach_variants, descent_text and dist_km already describe
results.evidence: STRUCTURAL: itinerary.days[0] (title, note, objective, and the ~9:00 AM, ~12:00 PM and 2:00 PM schedule items), itinerary.days[1] note and last schedule item ('retrace Day 1's ridge traverse'), itinerary.cal ('camping on Ragged Ridge'), itinerary.totalNote ('high camp on Ragged Ridge') and timing.sectionBreakdown[0].note all describe the Ragged Ridge crest traverse over Cub Peak, while every other field describes dropping from Easy Pass into Fisher Creek past Fisher Camp and climbing the south basin to a ~6,700 ft shoulder camp; the day-1 plan should be rewritten to the Fisher Creek line (one party on that line reached flat ground at the 6,700 ft rib step 4.2 hr from the car). Both lines are documented by one detailed report each (Fisher Creek line; crest over Cub Peak with a bivy west of Kitling), and a peak page describes a third, a traverse west below the ridge from just before Easy Pass without descending to Fisher Creek, so no source ranks one as standard and the rewrite would need schedule times no source states. dist_km (12.1) already matches the approach text's ~12 km one way, so the distance half of this item is settled on the live row.

results.fact: recommended/actual start time from high camp
results.evidence: Third attempt; further Gunsight/Chikamin Glacier reports were searched. Parties' start times range from pre-dawn single pushes to a 10:00 AM departure on a climbing day, and the detailed 2017 schedule broke the col camp in the morning and summited in the evening; none states a customary start from high camp or recommends either 4-5am or 7:00 AM. Neither the turnaround line nor timing.recommendedStart/the day-3 schedule is changed.

Third attempt. An archived route page for the East Face gives Grade III and 5.3; the route database still gives Grade I; the club route page gives only 3rd/4th/mid-5th class and 7-9 hr trailhead to summit, with no numeral. No source gives Grade II (the grade column), and I and III each have only one source, so the range rule cannot apply and neither grade nor commitment is changed.

Third attempt. A climbing-club route page for the North Col from Barlow Pass states 5,200 ft of gain, matching gain_ft/loss_ft; the other club page's 3,600 ft to the col (3,900 total) cannot be measured from Barlow Pass (2,360 ft) to 7,136 ft; a 2019 party logged 4,800 ft over 16.5 mi from Barlow Pass but on an unsuccessful North Couloir attempt, so it is not a summit total. Only one source states a car-to-car summit total, so neither gain_ft nor the itinerary/totalNote 4,800 is changed.

results.evidence: Third attempt. None repeats 3,670 or 3,800 and no two agree, so neither gain_ft nor loss_ft/itinerary is changed.

Third attempt; no new total was found (the other pages found give only the 2.8 mi / 2,700 ft approach to the base). The two stated car-to-car figures remain 3,156 ft (route log) and ~3,020 ft (921 m, GPS trip report); they are close but not the same, both are single-party measurements, and both sit between gain_ft 2,700 (the approach-to-base figure) and the itinerary/totalNote 3,500. Nulling both would be allowed only if each were provably wrong, which two differing party logs do not establish for 3,500, so nothing is changed.
